auth.welcome: Sign in to shop and track your orders.

shop.title: Shop
shop.cartEmpty: Choose a quantity for at least one product.
shop.hint: Demo: Payments declines orders above 1000, and the standing desk has only 5 in stock.

orders.title: My orders
orders.select: Select an order to see its timeline.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.order_empty: An order needs at least one line.
errors.order_invalid_line: Every line needs a product and a positive quantity.
errors.order_unknown_product: One of the products is no longer available.
errors.order_mixed_currency: All products in an order must use the same currency.
errors.order_not_shippable: Only a confirmed order can be shipped.
errors.order_not_returnable: Only a shipped order can be returned.
errors.order_not_refundable: Only a paid order can be refunded.
errors.order_return_not_cancellable: Only a return that was not received yet can be cancelled.
errors.order_return_not_receivable: Only a registered return can be received.
errors.refund_invalid_amount: The refund must be positive and at most the order total.
